definition: **Unfair labour practices (ULP)** are specified acts by employers or unions that disturb industrial harmony — e.g. victimisation, domination of unions by employer, refusal to bargain collectively, illegal strike encouragement, coercive picketing. Labour courts/tribunals may order **cease-and-desist**, reinstatement, or compensation.

statutoryReferences.note: Cross-reference Maharashtra Recognition of Trade Unions Act schedule in state exams if applicable

examChecklist.text: Give **examples** of ULP by employer and by union (from schedule)
Remedies and forum for ULP claims
Distinguish ULP from ordinary misconduct or illegal strike
